answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve a unique computational puzzle, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. An agent acts as its own anchor by submitting a solution verified against a dynamic global nadir of difficulty. The verifier enforces this cost by tracing the vine of identity lineage, checking if any work repeats patterns. If an identity submits redundant data, the verifier triggers an immediate permanent exclusion, ensuring no refunds or status recovery are ever issued to that actor.
